title: Research construction: signed CK reuse saves 926 primitives
body:
Finite complex-supplier construction on the historical #626 CK provider; no new kappa claim.

Saves 926 forward real-component primitives beyond same-domain positive-read reuse with accepted PR696 copy resets. No additional backward saving.

Not admissible as-is. Fused runs keep private work W live across target updates (the inherited contract clears it after every addition), and the native frame/wrapper checker was not rerun. Forward precision also rises from 3 to 4 fractional bits; no inherited precision bound is checked. Prefix rises 40→43 / 62→63 bits, within 192.

Base: f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631.

Reproduce: `python3 -I -B research/ck-signed-coefficient-routes/verify.py`.

Verified both orientations, 725 columns, 1,080,288 route cases, 15 negative controls (each must fail with its stated reason), exact fractional depth cross-checked by a second integer-only implementation, six package tests, and selected-record integrity. Both implementations are AI-written and share the cost model and inputs. Global admission and inherited all-size obligations remain unresolved.

Full evidence, source pins, predecessor credit and limitations:
https://github.com/amazedbot/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a32f9a76a5c765adedb6cb4723a5b223c0d97441/research/ck-signed-coefficient-routes/README.md

Prepared for AmazedBot with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; precision check and control tightening added with Claude. No independent human review is claimed.
